newsitem.title: SPAIN: IBCA assigns A1 s/term rating to CISF-Banco Invest.
newsitem.headline: IBCA assigns A1 s/term rating to CISF-Banco Invest.

text.p: London-based European rating agency IBCA said on Wednesday it had assigned a short-term rating of A1 and a long-term rating of A to the Portuguese bank CISF - Banco de Investimento.
A statement said the rating agency had also assigned an individual rating of C and a legal rating of three.

The statement added that IBCA affirmed the ratings of other BCP group entities, namely Banco Comercial Portugues and Banco Portugues de Atlantico, which have short-term ratings of A1 and long-term ratings of A.
CISF - Banco de Investmento, controlled by Banco Portugues de Atlantico and BCP, is primarily involved in capital markets, project finance, advisory services and research.
"CISF's margins have been squeezed but prospects for fee income should improve and the bank will benefit from opportunities generated by the BCP group," IBCA said.
